plain.li: [match,warm,letter] Your letter was read at our table, and the yeses started before the end of it.
[match,warm,call] We'd have said yes before you finished asking, {WRITER}. Welcome to the family.
[match,cordial,theirHightech] We have gone over the terms with the family, and we agree. Our good wishes to the two of them.
[match,cordial,theirLowtech] The old ones asked their questions and got their answers. We say yes.
[match,cool,theirLowtech] We agree, for what it will bring both our peoples. Love can come after.
[match,cool,letter] Yes. See that the terms are kept, and that ours is treated well among you.
[match,refusal,letter] We have no wish to tie our family to your colony. Do not take it as an insult, though some here meant it as one.
[match,refusal,theirHightech,call] I'm sorry, {WRITER}. The family put it to a vote, and it was no.
[greetings,warm,tie:marriage:theirs,!match:child] Give {INLAW} our love, and tell them their old bed is still made up at home.
[greetings,warm,tie:marriage:ours,!match:child] {SPOUSEOF} is well, and asks after everyone at your colony by name.
[greetings,cordial,tie:marriage:theirs,!match:child,theirLowtech] We trust {INLAW} keeps our ways among you, and learns yours.
[greetings,cordial,tie:marriage:ours,!match:child,theirHightech] {SPOUSEOF} has settled in well, and sends greetings and a list of things they forgot to pack.
[greetings,cool,tie:marriage] Your letter came. The family is well.
[news,cordial,tie:marriage] Here is our news, from one side of the family to the other.
[help,warm,tie:marriage] Family helps family, {WRITER}. You didn't need to ask twice.
[condolences,warm,tie:marriage] We grieve with you as kin, {WRITER}. Our house mourns too.
[warning,warm,tie:marriage] Thank you for thinking of us. Kin warn kin, and we will do the same for you.
[invitation,warm,tie:marriage,!match:child] Of course we'll come. It's been too long since we saw the two of them.
[greetings,cordial,match:agreed] The whole family is getting ready for the wedding, and arguing about who sits where.
[greetings,cordial,match:agreed,theirHightech] The arrangements for the wedding are coming along. There is a list, and the list has lists.
[news,cordial,match:agreed] Here is our news, though the wedding is all anyone here talks about.
[greetings,curt,match:wronged] We have your letter. We have not forgotten what your colony did.
[help,refusal,match:wronged,theirLowtech] You ask us for help, after what was done to one of ours? No.
[condolences,cool,match:wronged] We read of your loss. We have had one too, at your colony's hands.
[greetings,cordial,town:lately:dip:wedding] The wedding is still the talk of the town here.
[greetings,warm,town:lately:dip:wedding,theirLowtech] The songs from the wedding are still being sung here at night.
[matchask,us,kind] I hope you'll hear me out, this matters a great deal to me.
[matchask,us,!lowtech] Our colony would like to propose a marriage between our families.
[matchtalk,them,theirLowtech] Who would stand for each family on the day?
[matchtalk,them,theirHightech] Who would draw up the terms, your side or mine?
[matchtalk,us] You'd be family to all of us, not only to one.
[matchtalk] It would tie our two peoples together for good.
[matchyes,them,kind] Yes, and I'm happier about it than I'll admit to my family.
[matchyes,them] My people will want a wedding worth the walk, then.
[matchno,them,abrasive] No, and don't ask me again.
[matchno,them,kind] I'm sorry, it's nothing you've done, it's what my family wants.
[matchfarewell,us,kind] Look after each other while I'm gone, all of you.
[matchfarewell,us,lowmood] I didn't think leaving would be this hard.
[matchfarewell,us] Don't let them turn my bed into a storeroom.
[matchescort,them,theirLowtech] The family has kept a place for you at the table.
[matchescort,them,kind] Take your time with the goodbyes, we'll wait.
[matchescort,them] Come on, everyone at home wants to meet you.
